title: Add User Profile Card
content: Create profile card. Container: bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-6 text-center. Avatar: w-24 h-24 rounded-full mx-auto mb-4, border-4 border-white shadow. Name: text-xl font-bold. Title/bio: text-gray-500. Stats: flex justify-center gap-8 my-4, posts/followers/following counts. Actions: flex gap-2 justify-center, Follow button (primary), Message button (secondary).

variants.simple: Create user profile card with avatar, info, and actions.
variants.detailed: Create profile card. Container: bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-6 text-center. Avatar: w-24 h-24 rounded-full mx-auto mb-4, border-4 border-white shadow. Name: text-xl font-bold. Title/bio: text-gray-500. Stats: flex justify-center gap-8 my-4, posts/followers/following counts. Actions: flex gap-2 justify-center, Follow button (primary), Message button (secondary).
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive user profile card. Layout variants: horizontal (for list), vertical (for grid), compact (minimal info). Cover image: optional banner at top with gradient overlay. Avatar: multiple sizes, online status indicator (green dot), verified badge, click to view full size. User info: name, username (@handle), pronouns, bio (with link parsing), location, website link, join date. Verification: badge for verified accounts with tooltip. Stats: follower/following counts (clickable to show list), posts/content count, other relevant metrics. Action buttons: Follow/Unfollow (toggle state), Message, More menu (block, report, share profile). Follow states: not following, following, follows you (badge), mutual follow. Edit mode: if viewing own profile, show Edit Profile button instead. Social links: icons for connected platforms. Skills/tags: badge list of skills or interests. Mutual connections: "Followed by X, Y and 3 others you follow". Loading: skeleton state matching layout. Responsive: adapt layout for different contexts. Accessibility: all actions keyboard accessible, proper heading hierarchy.
